data_and_seed_provenance.key_note: legacy uint32 raw keys (jax.random.split of the numpy row); key_resampling is the exact key passed to soft_resampling
data_and_seed_provenance.data_generation: the script's own synthetic data: 5-component Gaussian mixture prior in d=8 (means U(-5,5), covs a a^T + I), 1000 prior samples via diffres.tools.sampling_gm, linear Gaussian likelihood (obs_op ones(1,8), obs_cov I, y = obs_op @ sum_c v_c m_c), exact posterior via diffres.tools.gm_lin_posterior and 1000 posterior samples; normalised log importance weights log_ws

limitations: Reduced size (n=1000, one MC id) relative to run_gms.sh (n=10000, 100 MC ids); metric values are a single-seed reference, not the paper's averages.
